label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a2 trial, late in the episode (low value), agent about to repeat a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass). Nearly all mass (>99%) comes with reward input 1 where the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 (prev_action==2 and prev_common==0 carry 94% of mass; prev_action==1 never fires). It is also confined to the end of the episode: ep_trial 90-99 holds 95% of mass, 80-89 holds the rest, and it never fires before trial 80. This shows up as the model value head being in its bottom bin (<5.22, 99.6% of mass), which is why value stands in for episode position. The agent always picks a2 next (action==2 at D1; this is the agent own upcoming choice, a legitimate FUTURE variable; leaving it out drops dev F1 from 0.63 to 0.55 with the same recall), with the policy logit only mildly favoring a2 (choice -4.4..-1.5). So it fires where a rare-rewarded a2 trial should, model-based, push a switch to a1, yet the agent stays on a2 near the episode end. Dev: P 0.53, R 0.76, F1 0.63, mass recall 0.93. Weak activations are the missed cases (rewarded common trials and similar contexts). About half of the matching D1 steps stay silent, so precision is incomplete. Never fires at GO or D2, after unrewarded trials, or after a1 trials.
